note: Alternative models for development comparisons. The evaluated model stays in model-manifest.json, which the research integrity check pins by hash. Revisions, licences and architectures were read from the Hugging Face API on 2026-10-27. "dtype" applies on Apple Silicon; NVIDIA GPUs use bfloat16 where supported. A new entry may start with a null revision; scripts/download_model.py --pin records it.

qwen3-vl-4b.purpose: Next-generation Qwen at a similar size to the evaluated 3B model

qwen3-vl-8b.purpose: Larger Qwen; separates model size from task design

qwen3.5-9b.purpose: Newest natively multimodal Qwen that fits a 48 GB Mac without quantisation

gemma-4-e4b.purpose: Second model family; small enough to consider for on-phone use
